english.title: Bring a consignment of products not complying with import requirements into a free / customs warehouse

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) brought a consignment of products specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCTS..), that did not comply with the import requirements of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011 into

(A)_[a warehouse in a free zone]_
(B)_[a free warehouse]_
(C)_[a customs warehouse]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28, 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
NoneOn the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
